text: DSM-Firmenich AG, the parent company of the dsm-firmenich group, is a company organized under Swiss law with its registered office in Kaiseraugst, and its shares have a dual listing on Euronext Amsterdam and the SIX Swiss Exchange; it had 253,626,947 shares outstanding on 26 February 2026.

source.name: dsm-firmenich investors: Shareholder structure
source.quote: In connection with the dual listing of the Company on both Euronext Amsterdam and SIX Swiss Exchange
